title: Symbol Prefix Counter

statement.md: A symbol directory holds $n$ words (repeats allowed). For each of $q$ query prefixes, print how many of the $n$ words start with that prefix. Count repeated words as many times as they appear. A word is a prefix of itself.

inputFormat: First line: $n$. Second line: $n$ words. Third line: $q$. Fourth line: $q$ prefixes. All are 1 to 20 lowercase letters.

examples.input:
5
spy spyder spy aapl amzn
4
sp spy a z

hints: Scanning every word for every query is $O(nq)$.
Store a count in each trie node: how many words pass through it.
editorial: [{"type": "p", "md": "Insert every word into a trie, adding one to a counter in each node along the path. A query walks its prefix; the count in the last node is the answer, or $0$ if the walk falls off the trie. Building costs $O(\\sum |w|)$ and each query costs $O(|prefix|)$. A hash map of all prefixes also works but stores $\\sum |w|$ strings."}]
